name: Mini Browser
description: In-app web browser with a real rewriting proxy — a vendored Ultraviolet (AGPL-3.0) intercepted client-side by a service worker, backed by this app's own TompHTTP Bare Server v3 (written from the open spec, no Node/Wisp/new process). Ships a resizable dev panel (Requests/Console) next to the Go button. Three independent MCP tool sets: browser_* pilots the shared aw-app-browser container over CDP (ported from aw-app-devctl); browser_screenshot_view renders this window's own iframe via devctl's side-container-free Playwright; minibrowser_* is Playwright-style remote control of a REAL, already-open Mini Browser window via devctl's tab relay + a postMessage bridge — not a piloted or headless browser at all.

skills.description: What Mini Browser is and how its MCP tools actually work — it pilots the separate shared aw-app-browser (noVNC) container over CDP, not its own iframe. Use whenever asked to pilot a browser for quick assisted navigation/debugging, or when a mini-browser MCP call errors with "aw-app-browser not reachable over CDP".

home_url.description: URL the browser loads on open and on the home button.

apps.reason: GET /view/screenshot and the browser_screenshot_view MCP tool delegate to devctl's POST /render/screenshot (a side-container-free Playwright renderer). Without devctl installed, everything else in Mini Browser still works — only that one screenshot path 502s.
